value.title: Bounded local SQLite phases preserve rendering and distinguish return from content ready
value.statement: Fixed enum timings/counts observe the existing bridge IO queue, layer lock, gate, cache, RTree, attributes/BLOB/full decode, style/clip/labels, PBF and Main dispatch without extra DB, geometry, memory or native SDK reads. Preserve original geometry, attributes, gates, free-only admission, cache keys and current/cancellation guards. At most16 scopes and32 layer summaries share one observer and bounded writer; local LISA-SqlitePhase logs are throttled10s per layer, final suppressed outcomes flush later and observation loss is explicit. Clock/writer/watch failures do not change caller outcomes or leak closed scopes; unavailable timing is not zero. Only numeric layer/source/content IDs, zoom and allowlisted phases/counts may appear, with no URI, tile X/Y, coordinates, business fields or exception messages. provider_returned, returned_to_sdk, cancelled and failed are separate; Java return never establishes native content ready or a performance/Full/2GiB acceptance.
